title: Mr Bloom moved nimbly aside
html_source: In differentiating Bloom through physicality again, Joyce extends the distinction with a heroic aspect to the movement and allusion to Odysseus.

anchor.prefix:
ambert nodded. 

 — But listen to this, he said. 

 The doorknob hit Mr Bloom in the small of the back as the door was pushed in. 

 — Excuse me, J. J. O'Molloy said, entering.
anchor.suffix:
. 

 — I beg yours, he said. 

 — Good day, Jack. 

 — Come in. Come in. 

 — Good day. 

 — How are you, Dedalus? 

 — Well. And yourself? 

 J. J. O'Molloy shook his head.
